description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Inspection Method provides a way to interact with the [Inspection Method - Read API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_INSPECTIONMETHOD_SRV/overview). The service allows to read inspection methods, the master data records that describe the procedure for performing the quality inspection of a characteristic, with their settings, administrative data and texts.
key-features: Read inspection methods with their settings and administrative data
Read the language-dependent texts of inspection methods
Filter, sort and page results with OData query options
